title: Customizations In Place
description: 1 · Turn Zero — in the session (this session). What a new session starts with is a one-line summary above the new-session composer (agent, capabilities and connections, what's unavailable), which expands into an adjustable card with session-only switches. After the first request it becomes a pinned header at the top of the transcript; expand it to see or change the setup, with changes applying from the next request. The first reply visibly respects what you chose. Follow-up to Customizations Rethink; vetted and cut by the design council.
